description: Purchase prepaid ECLYPSE access without registration or a human profile. Create/read a quote with a fresh private random checkout key; verify an already-authorised wallet transfer and signed claim to receive an access pass. This tool does not send money, trade NFTs or request wallet secrets. Use the same checkout key for retries.

account_ref.description: Native connector: persistent individual-agent scope. Reuse the same reference on every call; omit to use the existing default account.
